description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain factory and grain type resolution mechanisms, validating behaviors such as ambiguous resolution, full name and prefix-based resolution, inheritance, and multiple interface support.

classes.name: GrainFactoryTests
classes.description: A test class validating Orleans grain factory resolution and behavior under various scenarios.

methods.name: GetGrain_Ambiguous
methods.description: Tests that resolving a grain interface with multiple implementations throws an ArgumentException.

methods.name: GetGrain_Ambiguous_WithDefault
methods.description: Validates that Orleans uses the default implementation when multiple grains implement the same interface.

methods.name: GetGrain_WithFullName
methods.description: Checks resolution of a grain using its fully qualified class name.

methods.name: GetGrain_WithPrefix
methods.description: Tests grain resolution via a class prefix.

methods.name: GetGrain_AmbiguousPrefix
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when a prefix matches multiple grains.

methods.name: GetGrain_WrongPrefix
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when a prefix does not match any registered grain.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_NoPrefix
methods.description: Resolves a derived grain interface without specifying a prefix.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithFullName
methods.description: Resolves a derived grain using its full class name.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithFullName_FromBase
methods.description: Accesses a derived grain via its base interface using full name.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithPrefix
methods.description: Resolves a derived grain with a prefix.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithWrongPrefix
methods.description: Ensures an exception occurs for an invalid prefix on a derived grain.

methods.name: GetGrain_OneImplementation_NoPrefix
methods.description: Automatically resolves the only implementation of an interface without prefixes.

methods.name: GetGrain_OneImplementation_Prefix
methods.description: Explicitly resolves a single implementation using its full name.

methods.name: GetGrain_MultipleUnrelatedInterfaces
methods.description: Resolves grains implementing multiple unrelated interfaces.

methods.name: GetStringGrain
methods.description: Tests grain resolution using string keys.

methods.name: GetGuidGrain
methods.description: Tests grain resolution using GUID keys.
